identity: This is an inactive Regulator.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground, loading the unit with 7.50mm rounds and 40x46mm grenades in your inventory and turning it on.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully the drone will then identify you as a friendly, roam around or follow you, and attack all enemies with a built-in firearm and grenade launcher.
